recalled_knowledge.item: solar age 4.6 Gyr, M_sun = 1.989e33 g, R_sun = 6.9634e10 cm
AGSS09ph standard solar model composition and density profile as shipped with WimPyC (rho_c ~ 150 g/cm3, T_c = 1.4e7 K)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Serenelli, Basu, Ferguson, Asplund, ApJL 705, L123 (2009) via WimPyC
Baxter et al. 2021; de Salas & Widmark 2021

recalled_knowledge.item: Sommerfeld enhancement of Higgsino WW/ZZ at v ~ 1e-3 c is O(1-3); dark-photon saturation S_sat = 6 alpha_D m/m_A'
solar evaporation mass ~ 3-4 GeV for elastic WIMPs
IceCube 2016-2022 solar WIMP searches (IC79/86, 3-7 yr): at 1 TeV sigma_SD(W+W-) ~ 1e-41 - 1e-40 cm^2, sigma_SI ~ 1e-43 cm^2; tau tau similar, b bbar ~30x weaker
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: IceCube, EPJC 77, 146 (2017); IceCube PRD 105, 062004 (2022) [low mass]; JCAP 04 (2016) 022

recalled_knowledge.item: ANTARES 11-yr solar WIMP limits: sigma_SD(W+W-, 1 TeV) ~ 1e-40 cm^2 (few e-41 - 3e-40)
Super-K solar WIMP search covers m <= 200 GeV (sigma_SD ~ 1e-39 at 200 GeV, b bbar); no TeV reach
channel scaling of solar limits at 1 TeV: tau tau ~ W+W- (x1-2), b bbar ~ 20-50x weaker; A'A' -> 4 tau at E_A' = m_chi behaves like tau tau at m_chi/2 with 2 x BR(tau) yield
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: IceCube 2017 channel comparison; Batell, Pospelov, Ritz, Shang 2010 (secluded DM in the Sun)

recalled_knowledge.item: a direct nu nubar line is ~3x more constraining than tau tau per annihilation at TeV energies (absorption in the Sun limits the gain)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: IceCube/ANTARES channel comparisons; Rott, Siegal-Gaskins, Beacom 2011

recalled_knowledge.item: muon range in the solar core: dE/dx ~ 2 MeV g^-1 cm^2 x 150 g/cm3 -> a 500 GeV muon stops in ~20 m, far below its 3e6 m decay length; pi/K likewise stop -> only tau, c, b give hard neutrinos
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: standard Sun-annihilation neutrino lore (Jungman, Kamionkowski, Griest 1996)

recalled_knowledge.item: thermalisation of inelastic-only DM in the Sun stalls once v_core < sqrt(2 delta/mu); loop-level elastic Higgsino sigma ~ 1e-49 cm^2 cannot complete it
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Nussinov, Wang, Yavin 2009; Menon et al. 2010; P007/P039

recalled_knowledge.item: chi2 lifetimes: Higgsino tau_gamma ~ 0.06 s, tau_nunu 1.2e6 s; dark photon >= 7e16 s; Z' B-L 1.7e10 s (corpus values, not recalled from literature)

Elastic reference recomputed per (model, delta) took 125 s -> replaced by one unit-cross-section run per model with linear scaling.
Broadcasting error in the exothermic-window upper edge fixed.
Fig. 1 y-label clipped and Fig. 3 legend over the bars -> suptitle and below-axis legend.
